subject.title: fix(runtime): cancelled workflows no longer continue external commands

question: Should Lobster retain workflow resume state through all async setup and consume the resolved canonical resume state only once the first workflow step has begun execution, as this PR implements?
rationale: This is an externally observable session-state and side-effect-replay contract; source review can assess consistency, but maintainers must choose the intended retry-versus-replay boundary.

options.title: Confirm the execution boundary
options.body: Approve preserving tokens during setup cancellation and consuming canonical state after the first step-dispatch boundary to prevent replay.

options.title: Choose a different lifecycle contract
options.body: Specify a different point for consuming workflow resume capabilities, then adjust the implementation and regression coverage to match it.

recommendation.title: Confirm the execution boundary
recommendation.body: Approve preserving tokens during setup cancellation and consuming canonical state after the first step-dispatch boundary to prevent replay.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the most direct context on the cancellation boundary and its regression coverage, though final product ownership should be confirmed by a repository maintainer.
